brand.name: CAGECRAFT
tagline_lines: Combat sports roots. Built for everywhere else.
Built for dominance. Made to withstand.
brand.audience: MMA / BJJ / Muay Thai / boxing people and gym-goers 18-34 who also wear fight culture as streetwear; Australia first
brand.shipping_truth: Ships Australia-wide via AusPost (standard from $4.95) and internationally. There is NO free-shipping offer and NO sitewide discount right now, so never show one.

truth_rules: Every product claim must come from this file. Do not invent specs, awards, athlete endorsements, customer counts, star ratings, press quotes, discounts, free shipping, guarantees or scarcity.

Reviews: only the verbatim review quotes listed under a product may be shown as customer reviews, attributed as written here. Do not write new ones or edit their wording (trimming with an ellipsis is fine).
Prices are AUD. Show as $109.95 or A$109.95. No compare-at / was-now pricing exists.
